dashboard-overview.title: Dashboard overview
dashboard-overview.summary: Understand filters, metrics, and reading distribution.

filters.title: Filter the dashboard
filters.description: Use school, class, shift, month, and year filters to focus the dashboard on the group you want to review.

monthly.title: Monthly update status
monthly.description: This area calls out students who still need a reading update for the selected month.

improved.title: Students who improved
improved.description: This card is clickable. Select it to open the list of students who moved forward in their reading level this month.

attention.title: Students needing attention
attention.description: This card is clickable. Select it to open the students whose current reading level needs closer follow-up.

missingUpdates.title: Missing monthly updates
missingUpdates.description: This card is clickable. Select it to open the students with assessments still pending for the selected month.

distribution.title: Reading distribution
distribution.description: These charts summarize how students are distributed across reading levels.

student-assessment.title: Student assessment flow
student-assessment.summary: Learn how to update a student's reading level.

filters.title: Find the right student
filters.description: Search and filter by school, class, month, and year before updating a reading assessment.

metrics.title: Use action cards
metrics.description: These cards help you jump to students needing attention, monthly updates, or improvement review.

updateButton.title: Open the assessment form
updateButton.description: Start from Update Level. The tour will open the form without saving anything.

levelField.title: Choose the reading level
levelField.description: Select the student's current reading level for this assessment.

dateField.title: Confirm the date
dateField.description: The assessment date controls which month receives the update.

actions.title: Save or cancel
actions.description: Saving records the reading assessment. Cancel closes the form without changing data.

invite-teachers.title: Invite Teachers
invite-teachers.summary: Create and share teacher invite links.

inviteCard.title: Teacher invitations
inviteCard.description: Use this section to invite teachers to access their school.

openInvite.title: Open the invite form
openInvite.description: The tour will open the invite form without submitting it.

schoolField.title: Choose the school
schoolField.description: Pick the school where the teacher should be assigned.

nameField.title: Enter the teacher name
nameField.description: The name appears in the user list and invite details.

emailField.title: Enter the email
emailField.description: The teacher uses this email to accept the invite and create a password.

actions.title: Create the invite
actions.description: Creating an invite generates a shareable link. This tour does not submit the form.

pendingInvites.title: Pending invites
pendingInvites.description: Pending invites stay here until the teacher accepts them or they are removed.

parent-report-sharing.title: Parent report sharing
parent-report-sharing.summary: Generate and share a student reading report.

openProfile.title: Open a student profile
openProfile.description: Reports are shared from the student profile, so start by opening a student.

contacts.title: Parent contacts
contacts.description: Save parent or guardian contacts to make sharing reports easier.

reportCard.title: Report sharing
reportCard.description: Generate a secure report link for the family to view reading progress.

reportActions.title: Copy or share
reportActions.description: Use these actions to generate, copy, or share the report link.

history.title: Reading history context
history.description: The report is most useful when the student's reading history is up to date.

student-profile.title: Student profile walkthrough
student-profile.summary: Review profile details, progress, history, and comments.

openProfile.title: Open a student profile
openProfile.description: Profiles collect reading progress, contacts, reports, and history in one place.

summary.title: Profile summary
summary.description: Start here to confirm the student, school, class, and number.

currentLevel.title: Current level
currentLevel.description: This badge shows the latest recorded reading level.

reportEntry.title: Family reporting
reportEntry.description: Parent contacts and report sharing sit near the top for quick access.

charts.title: Progress charts
charts.description: Charts show how the student's reading level has changed over time.

history.title: Reading history
history.description: The timeline lists assessments and commentaries in chronological context.

commentary.title: Add commentary
commentary.description: Use commentaries to add qualitative notes without changing the reading level.

monthly-follow-up.title: Monthly follow-up workflow
monthly-follow-up.summary: Review pending, attention, and improved student lists.

monthly.title: Start with the month
monthly.description: Monthly follow-up begins by checking which students still need updates.

missingCard.title: Open pending updates
missingCard.description: Click this card to open the students missing an assessment for the selected month.

actionFilters.title: Filter the action list
actionFilters.description: Use filters to narrow the review list to a school and month.

actionTable.title: Review students
actionTable.description: The table shows the students included in this follow-up list.

actionUpdate.title: Update from the list
actionUpdate.description: You can update a student's reading level directly from the follow-up list.

attentionCard.title: Review attention list
attentionCard.description: Click this card to open and review students who need closer attention.

improvedCard.title: Celebrate improvement
improvedCard.description: Click this card to open the list of students who improved during the selected period.
